body:
Record four reproducible P2 defects in the two nesting verbs and Grouping specification handling, audited at `ac6ad79ff6026abe5fc45538d6dfefadf03a8ca3`:

- #946: constructor-shaped ordinary selections lose their preflight answer and run twice, changing source-row partitions.
- #947: filtered dtplyr inputs containing `.SD` fail during typed metadata reconstruction.
- #948: dtplyr nesting collides with locked `.SDall`, `.xSD`, and `.iSD` bindings.
- #949: temporary local column renaming invalidates sf geometry-column metadata.

The dated note records causes, minimal inputs, controls, rejected leads, dependency versions, and limits. It includes four red-capable reproductions and five passing investigation harnesses. Each issue is an independent `bug` / `ready-for-agent` ticket with no blockers. This PR adds investigation material only; implementation remains in those issues.

Validation:

- Focused existing testthat suite: passed across nesting, Grouping plans/inspection, capture, structured keys, and optional dtplyr paths.
- Four reproduction scripts: exited 1 as intended on the audited code after positive controls; they detected the four reported defects.
- Independent specification oracle: 1,000 trees passed; local membership oracle: 3,744 grouping-set comparisons passed.
- Mixed dtplyr differential: 196 comparisons and 54 explicit factor-level refusal controls passed; 84 empty reconstruction cases passed.
- Typed inspection: 240 local/dtplyr/Arrow/live-DuckDB comparisons passed.
- `jarl check .`: passed.
- Package-aware `lintr::lint_package()` after `pkgload::load_all()`: passed.
- Context-budget and document-reference verifiers, plus `git diff --check`: passed.

All changed files are under the already excluded `investigation/` directory. This is Repository-only under the local-check policy; a full Review-ready check was not required. CI monitoring was not performed, as requested.
